model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the distribution of participant counts across different criteria. The vertical axis displays the criteria categories—Relevant FCs, FC Summary, Relevance Explanation, Clarity and Simplicity, Overall Summary, Filters, Veracity Explanation—listed in order from top to bottom. The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Participants,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 2.  Bars representing each criterion are colored in shades of teal and green, with “Relevant FCs” having the longest bar at a length corresponding to a value of 6 participants. “FC Summary” is represented by a bar with a length of 5, while “Relevance Explanation” and “Clarity and Simplicity” each have bars of length 3.  “Overall Summary” has a bar of length 2, and “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” both have bars with a length of 1.  The bars are arranged in descending order based on the number of participants, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
